messages:
Ava: Quick flag — saw a weird MRR bump after the int8 run. Lots of exact ties in reranker scores, reported MRR jumped depending on ordering.
Ravi: Seen this before in 2023-06 quant experiments. Our eval harness shuffles candidate order for tie-break; prod sorts stable by doc_id. Ties move items across top-k.
Sam: Which run id? I can grab logs.
Ravi: run: <https://redwood.internal/runs/2023-06-quant-17> — examples where score == 0.8125 after quant rounding, many docs identical.
Marta: We should pick a deterministic tie-breaker. Proposal: hash(doc_id, run_seed) so reproducible per-run. Snippet:
```
# deterministic tie-breaker (python)
import mmh3

def tie_key(score, doc_id, run_seed):
    h = mmh3.hash(f"{doc_id}-{run_seed}") & 0xffffffff
    return (score, h)

# sort by (-score, tie_key)
```
Ravi: Deterministic OK, but note it can amplify dataset-order bias vs averaging by random shuffle. Suggest we log both deterministic and seeded-random scores for sensitivity.
Ava: Also, candidate truncation during preproc sometimes causes docs to become text-identical; we should add a `truncated` flag in candidate metadata so we can filter ties caused by truncation.
Sam: I'll add `truncated` boolean to candidate metadata and expose tie-breaker option in eval config: options = ["prod_order","docid_hash","random_seeded"]. ETA: staging PR by EOD.
eval-bot: CI: test job passed — rerank-eval-harness updated in staging with tie-breaker config. (job 5421)
Marta: For reporting, compute NDCG and MRR under three policies: prod_order, docid_hash, random_seeded (fixed seed). Report deltas + bootstrap p-values. If delta > 0.5% and p < 0.01 flag as sensitive.
Ravi: I'll run a smoke: 10k queries, bootstrap 1k. Command:
```
./eval_harness --dataset rerank-smoke --tiebreaker docid_hash --bootstrap 1000 --out results/tb-dochash.json
```
Ava: Add a short note to model onboarding docs: "Quantized runs increase exact ties due to score binning; explicit tie-break policy required." Link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/model-onboard#quantization-caveats>
Sam: PR opened: <https://redwood.internal/pr/1234> — includes truncated flag, tie-break config, tests reproducing ordering delta.
Marta: I'll run full experiment tomorrow across core/longtail and post numbers. If direction is stable across policies we make docid_hash default and add dashboard note.
Ava: Thanks everyone — let's regroup after long-run results.
